theorems.name: Submission.lpf_wtc_chart_image_measurable_locally_finite
theorems.statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl Q) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)), IsOpen Ω → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → MeasurableSet (Φ '' Ω) ∧ ∀ K : Set (Eucl Q), IsCompact K → (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) (Φ '' Ω ∩ K) < ∞
